choices.why: There is no green velvet option, so this dark rolled-arm three-seater with black turned legs comes closest to the deep, classic sofa requested and echoes the black mantel.
A pair of linen wingback chairs with nailhead trim and dark legs gives a traditional, elegant fireside look and lightens the dark sofa.
At 292 x 231 cm, this traditional medallion rug is large enough to anchor the whole seating group, and its charcoal and cream tie the sofa and chairs together.
This dark espresso wood table with a classic X-base suits the space between the sofa and the fireplace well.
This large mirror with a champagne-gold geometric overlay frame fills the chimney breast and adds a refined touch above the black mantel.
The turned-column base and linen drum shade give this lamp a classic look that matches the wingbacks and the room's period details.

answer.why: A palette of charcoal, cream and dark wood with soft gold accents suits the black fireplace, the pale mint moldings and the warm floor, creating a classic, elegant living area around the hearth.
